# Allowed modification range: SH!A6:L11
min_row, max_row = 6, 11
min_col, max_col = 1, 12

def is_blank_row(row_cells):
    return all(cell.value is None or str(cell.value).strip() == "" for cell in row_cells)

# Capture all non-blank rows within the allowed range
kept_rows = []
for r in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
    cells = [ws.cell(r, c) for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1)]
    if not is_blank_row(cells):
        kept_rows.append([
            {
                "value": cell.value,
                "style": copy(cell._style),
                "number_format": cell.number_format,
                "font": copy(cell.font),
                "fill": copy(cell.fill),
                "border": copy(cell.border),
                "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
                "protection": copy(cell.protection),
            }
            for cell in cells
        ])

# Clear and refill only the allowed range, shifting non-blank rows upward
for idx in range(max_row - min_row + 1):
    target_row = min_row + idx
    for c_idx, col in enumerate(range(min_col, max_col + 1)):
        cell = ws.cell(target_row, col)
        if idx < len(kept_rows):
            src = kept_rows[idx][c_idx]
            cell.value = src["value"]
            cell._style = src["style"]
            cell.number_format = src["number_format"]
            cell.font = src["font"]
            cell.fill = src["fill"]
            cell.border = src["border"]
            cell.alignment = src["alignment"]
            cell.protection = src["protection"]
        else:
            cell.value = None

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
